multiplicity: Holm within each distinct predeclared family; no global FWER claim across families
coverage_events: Posterior PIT <= p and .05 <= PIT <= .95 for the continuous model; these directly measured CDFs avoid treating quantile inversion error as zero.

numerical_sensitivity.construction: PIT +/- (deterministic_component+z*MCSE), limited to probability support; PIT point estimates themselves never clipped.
numerical_sensitivity.interval_kind: Asymptotic CLT-based sensitivity; refinement component is observed-scale allowance, not a global certified bound.
numerical_sensitivity.resolved_for_function: High-level PIT MCSE passes; both-level pooled weight deletion and saturation guards pass; all six replicate contrasts at each level for this function and for logZ are resolved/compatible; its refinement and logZ refinement pass; independent ORF/kernel/reference validation is present. Other parameter-PIT failures are retained separately and do not by themselves replace this function by [0,1].
numerical_sensitivity.cdf_precision_of_low_selected_quantiles: Reported separately for quantile products; these twenty additional CDFs do not create twenty additional SBC PITs.

decision: Report nominal tests and simultaneous sensitivity bounds separately. Any failure of integration remains visible and is investigated; an attractive SBC curve never overrides a numerical failure.
quantiles: Weighted quantiles descriptive until horizontal numerical uncertainty is evaluated; CDF precision alone does not imply a horizontal .001 error bound.
